# MaximumEntropyNeuronalModels

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Statistical models that infer neuronal population activity distributions by maximizing entropy subject to observed pairwise correlations, including at criticality. Provides a principled framework for understanding collective neural dynamics and phase transitions, guiding neuromorphic design near critical regimes.
